_readme: Game tuning. Times are in milliseconds. Edit freely; restart the app to apply.

customer._readDelay: Live read delay (customer online in the chat), by persona 'read' speed. While BalanceDesk is open, pending customer replies come twice as fast.
customer._maxTurns: Customer replies after the question before they give up.
customer._think: After reading your message the customer thinks before typing: baseMs + perWordMs per word + perNumberMs per number (up to maxNumbers), times readSpeed, clamped to minMs..maxMs.
customer._meter: Hidden impatience (0-100, never shown to the player; it sets the customer's tone). Each customer reply adds 'perReply' by persona patience; pushing back on a wrong/unclear answer adds 'pushback'. At 100 they leave. VIPs tolerate 1-3 pushbacks calmly (vipGrace), then each pushback adds vipPushback.
customer._poke: While you keep them waiting, impatient customers (low patience, VIPs; others a quarter as often) who pop online after afterMs sometimes send a short poke. No pay penalty, unlike a real chase.

texts: hi, just checking you got my message

customer._stepAway: During a live back-and-forth a customer sometimes has to step away (chance per reply; x busyMult while at work) for a log-normal while (median awayMedianMin). They read what you sent when they're back and say so.

busyLines: sorry, meeting starting, back in a bit
my boss just walked in, give me a few minutes
gotta jump on a call, I'll read your reply after
freeLines: one sec, the kids need me
sorry, have to pop out for a bit, back soon
dinner's ready, back in a bit
vipLines: I have a call now. I'll read your answer afterwards.
Excuse me, something urgent came up. I'll be back shortly.

pay._formula: Pay = Base(rank) x VIP x (score/100) x (serviceMultBase + serviceMultPerStar*stars) x length x time x bonuses + tip

time._readme: Time factor from your average reply time: best at or under the ideal, falling linearly to 'atSlow' at the slow mark, then down to 'min' at twice the slow mark.

mentor._autoHints: Mentor messages you a hint when a customer has pushed back hintAfterPushbacks times in one chat (at most maxHintsPerChat per chat).
mentor._digest: Sunday digest from the mentor: weekday (0 = Sunday) and hour, your local time. Skipped if the app stays closed more than maxLateDays after.

world._readme: Async (Telegram-like) simulation in real time. It keeps running while the app is closed and is caught up on launch.
world._session: How long customers stay online once they open the app (log-normal; medians in minutes): at work ~1.5 min, free ~5 min, evenings longer; scaled by schedule (students/night owls longer, executives shorter) and reading speed.
world._brb: 'brb' moments (a customer or Diane stepping away mid-conversation) happen at most once every brbEveryHours, shared between everyone.

rush._readme: Rush shift (ask your boss): a few customers who stay online and expect fast replies.

boss._readme: Your manager Diane. Times are your local time. On shift she's online most of the time (short gaps, sometimes a meeting) and replies in replyDelayMs once she sees your message; off shift (while awake) she checks her phone offChecksPerHour; asleep outside 'awake'.

ping._readme: Unprompted messages from Diane: about events (delay eventDelayMs), and casual check-ins every everyHours (scaled by rapport: more often when you get on well).

review._readme: Monthly performance review on Diane's first shift of the month, for the previous month (needs minChats finished). 'exceeds' pays bonusChats x your base pay; two 'below' months in a row cost one raise step.

boss._stepAway: Sometimes after replying live Diane has to step away for a while; she comes back online after that and acknowledges it. 'urgent' = the one /urgent call per game.

shiftLines: jumping into a meeting, back in a bit
Ledger is losing his mind at the postman, back in 5
give me 10 min, fire to put out
offLines: walking Ledger, back in a bit
gotta go, Tom's calling me, back later

secondChance._readme: Questions you scored below belowScore on (or never answered) come back afterDays later from a different customer (chance = how likely a due one is picked for a new customer).

returning._readme: Chance that a new customer is someone you've helped before (at least minDaysAgo since their last chat). Loyal customers (last chat >= loyalStars) pay loyaltyMult; unhappy ones start out annoyed (angerStart).

team._readme: #support-team channel. Every simEveryMs the cheap customer model simulates the next 12 hours of team chatter (about messagesPer12h messages). Warnings about difficult customers go both ways; a coworker who gets a customer you warned about thanks you.
